source_evidence: Most brokers are compensated through a markup over the cost of the bond to the firm. This markup might be disclosed on your confirmation statement. If a commission is charged, it will be reported on your confirmation statement. You should ask your broker about markups and commissions.
answer: When buying a municipal bond through a broker, the broker may earn compensation through a markup above the price the firm paid for the bond. A markup may appear on your confirmation statement. If you are charged a commission, that should also be reported there. Ask your broker whether a markup or commission applies and check your confirmation statement for the details.
